prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=cat-in-the-hat-ai-trend) and add your photo (your porch, front door or path). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Take the creepy cat character and place it on the path in the uploaded image, near the far end, walking toward the door and watching toward the camera. The character: a tall, thin cat character the size of a grown man, standing upright like a person, like someone in a realistic furry cat costume with a stiff, smiling cat mask: black fur, a white furry chest, a white face with a wide frozen grin and dark eyes, white gloves, a very tall, slightly floppy red and white striped top hat and a big red bow tie. Keep the dark, low-light atmosphere and make it look like a hidden doorbell camera shot: the same porch, door, path, plants, cars and houses as in the uploaded image, at night, lit by one weak porch light and a distant street lamp, the ground a little wet and shiny. A wide fisheye view from about chest height beside the front door, with bent edges, soft grain, slight noise and muted, cold night colors. The character stands small in the frame at the far end of the path, its whole body in view from the tip of the hat to the feet. If the uploaded image shows no path, it stands in the middle of the open ground in front of the door. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one cat character. No people and no human face anywhere in the picture. No weapon, no blood. No text, no timestamp, no date, no camera icons, no logos, no watermark, no house numbers, no readable number plates.

prompts.text:
Grainy night doorbell-camera clip of this porch, one continuous shot with no cuts. The camera never moves: a fixed wide fisheye view with soft grain and noise. Keep the porch, the door, the path, the plants and the houses exactly as in the image, and keep the cat character exactly as in the image: the tall red and white striped top hat, the big red bow tie, the white furry chest, the black fur, the white gloves and the stiff smiling cat mask.
0-4 s: the tall cat character walks slowly up the path toward the camera with long, stiff, careful steps, getting bigger in the frame.
4-6 s: it stops close to the camera, tilts its head to one side, then lifts one gloved hand and waves at the camera.
6-10 s: it does a silly little dance on the spot: two side steps, a hip wiggle, a small spin with the hat wobbling, and a stiff, polite bow at the end.
Audio: quiet night sounds, a light breeze and soft footsteps on the path, then a soft, playful music-box tune during the dance. No talking, no screams. Exactly one character, the same character from start to end, its mask face never changes. No people, no extra limbs, no morphing. No text, no timestamp, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.text:
A real handheld phone video filmed through a window at night, one continuous shot. Keep the street, the cars, the buildings, the lights and the curtain edge exactly as in the image, and keep the cat character exactly as in the image: the tall red and white striped top hat, the big red bow tie, the white furry chest, the black fur, the white gloves and the stiff smiling cat mask.
0-5 s: the tall cat character stands perfectly still under the light and stares up at the window; its head tilts slowly to one side. The phone shakes a little and zooms in slowly.
5-6.5 s: the phone pulls back behind the curtain for a moment, as if hiding, and the view goes dark.
6.5-10 s: the phone peeks out again: the character now stands closer, in the same street, lifts one gloved hand and waves slowly at the window, then gives a small, happy bounce.
Audio: quiet night street sounds, a far car passing and a soft, eerie music-box tune. No talking, no screams. Exactly one character, the same character from start to end, its mask face never changes. No people, no extra limbs, no morphing. No text, no logos, no watermark.
